concerns.text: SC-003 says Spearman correlation is 'measured against the literature baseline' but names no baseline value or source. An implementer cannot confirm met-or-not. Specify the reference (e.g., a named literature rho or a minimum threshold) or state the comparison procedure.

SC-005 requires 'variance in band gaps explained by the top 5 compositional descriptors ... >80% explanatory power' but names no measurement procedure. RF feature importances or SHAP values do not directly yield 'variance explained'; specify the method (e.g., R² of a refit model on top-5 descriptors vs. full model) so the criterion is computable.

concerns.location: spec.md:FR-003 vs Edge Cases and Constitution VII
concerns.text: FR-003 uses inclusive [0.0, 6.0] eV and the edge case says a 0 eV metallic entry 'must be included but flagged', while Constitution VII mandates strict bounds (0 < gap < 6). The two behaviors are contradictory; a test cannot verify both. Pick one (strict exclusion per the constitution, with the edge case revised to a warning-only path) and state it.

'False-negative rate for identifying lead-free candidates' does not define the positive class (what counts as a lead-free candidate hit — composition contains no Pb? predicted gap in a target window?). Name the classification rule so the rate is reproducible.
